title: Docker Compose Full-Stack Integration & E2E Smoke Verification
acceptance_criteria: Validate Docker Compose multi-container stack: postgres, redis, ediens-api, and ediens-web cleanly start and communicate over ediens-network.
Nginx in ediens-web container properly proxies /api/ to http://ediens-api:8080/api/ preserving If-Match, Idempotency-Key, and traceparent headers.
Completely remove any remaining mock references or legacy mock stores from the repository.
Run ./scripts/smoke-test.sh against live stack with 100% passing tests for health, ping, all 10 OpenAPI endpoints, and 400/403/404/409/422/429 RFC 9457 error contracts.
Run ./scripts/verify.sh with exit code 0 and document final end-to-end verification report in docs/VERIFICATION.md.
